title: Enough for whom
lines: Enough for Everyone asks whether material security could become universal without limitless consumption.
The book’s answer is conditional optimism, grounded in infrastructure and institutional choices.

emotionalPlan.purpose: The book’s answer is conditional optimism, grounded in infrastructure and institutional choices.
voiceDirections: Clear and calm. Introduce the book plainly, with restrained curiosity.

objects.meaning: An inhabited home cutaway links electricity, water, food and washing as actual services.
Water capacity outside the home is distinct from delivery to it.
A distribution connection makes an available resource usable inside a home.
The delivery path closes the gap between supply and household access.

visual.meaning: Terracotta and sea-blue civic cutaway; one home connects energy, water, repair and access across changing scales.
